<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z ≈ 199.0, which likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral molecular mass of about 197.99 Da. A plausible elemental composition that matches this mass within typical mass‑spectrometric tolerance is C₉H₁₃NO₄.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H13NO4</final_answer>
